readerCopy.body: Shared money, credit, or authority is redistributed in a way that changes the relationship for the better. Contracts are revised, access is widened, or a private arrangement becomes transparent enough for each person to understand their real stake. Venus protects mutual value, while Pluto brings the deeper leverage and consequences into view. Under the trine, fairness reaches the structure of the agreement instead of stopping at a pleasant statement. Trust grows because the change can be seen in who controls the money and who has the power to leave.
